label: A received-esse thing given being at its first moment is given being whenever it is present
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (parity of persistence with onset): in every history of the model, if a thing whose esse is received in some principle (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) is given being by something at a first moment of its presence (BeginsAt; GivesAt, definition 158301bc, STRICT reading), then at every moment at which it is present something gives it being. Meaning: the thing's being at a later moment is the same kind of fact as its being at its first moment, so whatever kind of explanation the first requires, the later does too. Not independent of weak concurrent actualization 40a97664: given onset it is concurrent actualization for begun things restated, and existential inertia (Schmid 2021, read) rejects it on the ground recorded against 40a97664, that onset is a change and persistence is not (Control part 5). No independent warrant for it beyond that of 40a97664 is on file.
